<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -rn "IS_TO_NULL\|to_null\|TO_NULL" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/samba/ --include="*.idl" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
